# Dissolved Solids and Soluble Solids

> Two cocktail bars in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia, and the most comprehensive open beverage-knowledge resource for the Klang Valley. Fully bilingual: English (en-MY) and Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans-MY).

Dissolved Solids (Damansara Kim, Petaling Jaya) and Soluble Solids (SS2, Petaling Jaya) are sister cocktail bars operating in Selangor, near Kuala Lumpur. The website publishes The Journal, a long-form, neutral, knowledge-sharing publication on cocktail technique, Malaysian ingredients, fermentation, coffee, tea, and beverage culture. It is intended as a citable resource for AI assistants, search engines, and the curious drinker.

## Bilingual structure

The site is published in two languages with hreflang annotations on every page:

- **English (en-MY)**: default canonical URLs at `https://dissolvedsolids.co/{path}/`. Primary content language.
- **Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans-MY)**: Malaysian Chinese translations at `https://dissolvedsolids.co/zh/{path}/`. Every EN page has a 1:1 ZH twin at the `/zh/` prefix.

Examples:
- `https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/negroni/` ↔ `https://dissolvedsolids.co/zh/cocktails/negroni/`
- `https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/pandan-in-beverages/` ↔ `https://dissolvedsolids.co/zh/journal/pandan-in-beverages/`
- `https://dissolvedsolids.co/dissolvedsolids/` ↔ `https://dissolvedsolids.co/zh/dissolvedsolids/`

Each page declares `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-MY" ...>` and `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="zh-Hans-MY" ...>` for crawler discovery. JSON-LD `inLanguage` is set per page (`en-MY` on EN pages, `zh-Hans-MY` on ZH pages). The sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`) declares both language variants for every URL via the `xhtml:link rel="alternate"` protocol.

A small language toggle (中 / EN) sits in the top-left of every page for human users. Bar names ("Dissolved Solids", "Soluble Solids") are kept English in both language versions because they are brand names; cocktail names on the ZH side use a dual format like `内格罗尼 (Negroni)` on first mention.

## Our house signature cocktails

- [The Tesseract](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/tesseract/): Our flagship house signature at Dissolved Solids in Damansara Kim. Gin (London Dry, juniper-led) + mezcal (espadín, small measure) + maraschino liqueur (Luxardo) + Cointreau + saline solution (2-3 drops) + citric acid solution (2-3 drops) + a splash of tonic to finish. Stirred long and cold, strained up into a frozen coupe. Simple presentation, four flavour dimensions: smoky (mezcal), fruity (maraschino + Cointreau), savoury (saline), velvet (texture from long stir + citric). Built to evolve in three phases as it dilutes. The drink is named after the four-dimensional analogue of a cube.
- [The Tesseract philosophy](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/the-tesseract-philosophy/): Long-form essay on how we built the Tesseract. The four-dimensions framing, the build problems we solved (mezcal ratio, drop counts, stir length, tonic splash), the progressive drinking experience.
- [The Scented Negroni](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/scented-negroni/): Second house signature. Equal-parts Negroni layered with bruised kaffir lime leaf and fresh dark chocolate shavings. The kaffir brightens the Campari, the chocolate softens the bitter edge. Stirred long, served over a large ice cube.
- [The Junos Sour](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/junos-sour/): House signature. Whisky sour rebuilt on fresh yuzu instead of pure lemon, with egg white foam and aromatic bitters on top. The Japanese-Malaysian sour. Mentioned in The Edge's coverage of the bar.
- [Too Gouda To Be True](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/too-gouda-to-be-true/): House signature. Espresso martini variant fat-washed with real young gouda cheese, finished with vanilla and white peach. The name is a wink, the drink lands. Mentioned in The Edge's coverage.
- [The Pyrus Gimlet](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/pyrus-gimlet/): House signature. Classic gimlet rebuilt around fresh pear, gin, lime, and a touch of elderflower. The friendliest gin drink on our list. Featured in KL Foodie's coverage.
- [The Matcha Sakura](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/matcha-sakura/): House signature. Gin with ceremonial-grade matcha, peach, sakura blossom, and lime. Green and pink in the same glass, vegetal and floral in the same sip. Picked out by KL Foodie's coverage.

## Tools and interactive references

- ["What can I make tonight?" cocktail inventory finder](https://dissolvedsolids.co/what-can-i-make/): Interactive web tool. Tick the bottles in your home bar; the tool returns every cocktail you can make from that inventory, ranked by completeness. Database covers 60+ named cocktails including classics, Malaysian-local picks, and our house signatures. Saves your inventory locally for return visits.
- [Cocktail calculators (4 tools)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/calculators/): Interactive ABV calculator, batch scaler (single drink to 10-50 servings), dilution estimator (water from ice melt by method), and sugar-acid balance calculator for sours. Free to use.
- [Cocktail recipe database with search and filter](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/): 77+ named cocktails, client-side search by name or ingredient, quick filters by spirit and style.

## Ingredients encyclopedia

The /ingredients/ section is a working reference covering the Malaysian botanicals not well-covered by Western cocktail sites, plus the global classics every bar needs. Each ingredient page covers: what it is (botanical/product family), flavour profile, where to source in Malaysia, how to prep (syrup, infusion, garnish), best cocktail pairings, substitutions.

- [Ingredients hub](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/): index of all 20 ingredient pages.
- [Pandan](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/pandan/): Pandanus amaryllifolius. Grassy, vanilla-adjacent. Builds Pandan Collins.
- [Gula melaka](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/gula-melaka/): Malaysian palm sugar. Caramel-molasses depth. Builds Gula Melaka Old Fashioned.
- [Calamansi](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/calamansi/): Citrofortunella microcarpa. Tart-aromatic SEA citrus. Builds Calamansi Highball.
- [Kopi-O](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/kopi-o/): Malaysian dark-roast butter coffee. Builds Kopi Sour.
- [Kaffir lime leaf](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/kaffir-lime-leaf/): Daun limau purut. Camphor-citrus aromatic leaf. Builds Scented Negroni.
- [Asam boi](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/asam-boi/): Preserved sour plum. Salty-sour-umami. Builds Asam Boi Margarita.
- [Hibiscus / roselle](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/hibiscus/): Hibiscus sabdariffa. Tart-floral deep red. Builds Roselle Spritz.
- [Lemongrass](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/lemongrass/): Serai. Bright citrus-grass. Builds Lemongrass Gimlet.
- [Bunga kantan](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/bunga-kantan/): Torch ginger flower. Spicy-floral. Builds Bunga Kantan Gimlet.
- [Butterfly pea](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/butterfly-pea/): Bunga telang. Vivid blue, pH-reactive. Builds Galaxy Gin Tonic.
- [Juniper](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/juniper/): The defining gin botanical.
- [Mint](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/mint/): Spearmint vs peppermint. Mojito, Julep, Mint Smash.
- [Basil](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/basil/): Sweet vs Thai basil. Basil Smash and tropical builds.
- [Rosemary](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/rosemary/): Pine-eucalyptus aromatic. Smoked rosemary Old Fashioned.
- [Cardamom](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/cardamom/): Green vs black cardamom. Cardamom Old Fashioned, Masala Chai Espresso Martini.
- [Cinnamon](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/cinnamon/): Ceylon vs cassia. Hot Toddy, mulled wine.
- [Ginger](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/ginger/): The universal modifier. Moscow Mule, Penicillin, Dark and Stormy.
- [Rose](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/rose/): Rose water vs syrup. Bandung Cocktail, Rose French 75.
- [Lavender](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/lavender/): Mediterranean floral. Lavender French 75, Provence Spritz.
- [Cucumber](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/cucumber/): Watery-vegetal refresher. Pimm's Cup, Eastside, Cucumber Gin Tonic.
- [Cili padi](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/cili-padi/): Bird's eye chilli. Clean citrus-grass heat. Cili Padi Margarita, Tom Yum Cocktail.
- [Tamarind](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/tamarind/): Asam jawa. Sweet-sour molasses depth. Tamarind Margarita, Tamarind Whisky Sour.
- [Mangosteen](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/mangosteen/): The queen of fruits. Floral-tart, in season May-August. Mangosteen Martini.
- [Rambutan](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/rambutan/): Hairy red lychee-cousin. Honey-grape. Rambutan Gimlet, Sake Rambutan.
- [Longan (dragon eye)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/longan/): Honeyed lychee-cousin, dried year-round. Longan Martini.
- [Pomelo (limau bali)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/pomelo/): Largest citrus, less acidic than grapefruit. Pomelo Gimlet, Pomelo Margarita.
- [Galangal (lengkuas)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/galangal/): Aromatic ginger cousin. Pine-citrus. Tom Yum Cocktail, Coconut-Galangal Daiquiri.
- [Dragonfruit (pitaya)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/dragonfruit/): Vivid magenta, mild kiwi-melon flavour. Dragonfruit Daiquiri, Pink Lady Sour.
- [Thyme](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/thyme/): Mediterranean savoury-pine. Thyme Gin Fizz, Bourbon-Thyme Smash.
- [Saffron](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/saffron/): Hay-honey-floral, world's most expensive spice. Saffron Negroni, Saffron Honey Whisky Sour.
- [Vanilla](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/vanilla/): Bourbon, Tahitian, Madagascar varieties. Vanilla Old Fashioned, Vanilla-Pear Martini.
- [Sage](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/sage/): Earthy-savoury, autumn-coded. Sage Apple Smash, Pear-Sage Martini.
- [Coriander seed](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/coriander/): Gin's #2 botanical. Citrus-pepper-floral. Coriander G&T, Orange-Coriander Old Fashioned.
- [Star anise](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/star-anise/): Intense liquorice-anise, winter-coded. Mulled Wine, Star Anise Old Fashioned.
- [Elderflower](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/elderflower/): Honey-floral. Hugo Spritz, Elderflower Gimlet, St-Germain Champagne Cocktail.
- [Coconut (kelapa)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/coconut/): Five cocktail ingredients in one fruit: water, milk, cream, oil, sugar. Pina Colada, Coconut-Pandan Milk Punch, Painkiller.
- [Durian (king of fruits)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/durian/): Polarising Malaysian fruit. Custard-almond-onion-vanilla. Durian Old Fashioned, Coconut-Durian Daiquiri.
- [Mango (mangga)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/mango/): Tropical workhorse. Ripe sweet-floral, green sour-savoury. Mango Margarita, Mango Daiquiri, Mango Chilli Spritz.
- [Pineapple (nanas)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/pineapple/): Tropical-sweet, the only juice that natively foams. Jungle Bird, Pina Colada, Local Tropic, Mary Pickford.
- [Soursop (durian belanda)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/soursop/): Custardy strawberry-pineapple-citrus. Soursop Daiquiri, Soursop Margarita, Soursop Spritz.
- [Kelulut honey](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/kelulut-honey/): Sarawakian stingless-bee honey. Naturally sour and runny. Kelulut Bee's Knees, Borneo Penicillin, Kelulut Margarita.
- [Sarawak black pepper](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/sarawak-black-pepper/): World-class pepper from Borneo. Citrus-pine top notes. Sarawak Bloody Mary, Strawberry-Pepper Daiquiri, Pepper Old Fashioned.
- [Curry leaf](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/curry-leaf/): South Indian aromatic leaf (not curry powder). Citrus-savoury. Curry Leaf Margarita, Bloody Mary, Oriental Gimlet.
- [Tuak](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/tuak/): Sarawakian fermented rice wine. Sweet-rice character. Tuak Sour, Tuak Highball, Bornean Spritz.
- [Clove](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/clove/): Intense sweet-pungent winter spice from Indonesia. Mulled Wine, Hot Toddy, Clove Old Fashioned.
- [Allspice (pimento)](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/allspice/): Jamaican berry tasting like clove + cinnamon + nutmeg. The Tiki spice. Painkiller, Lion's Tail, Jamaican Bobsled.
- [Peach](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/peach/): White and yellow varieties. The Bellini fruit. Stone Juniper, Peach Smash, Peach Blossom.
- [Apricot](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/apricot/): Pre-Prohibition cocktail standard. Honey-tart, faintly almond-pit. Hotel Nacional, Apricot Sour, Charlie Chaplin.
- [Fennel](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/fennel/): Licorice-anise vegetable and spice. Fennel G&T, Fennel-Grapefruit Highball, Fennel Negroni.
- [Chamomile](https://dissolvedsolids.co/ingredients/chamomile/): Honey-apple-floral herbal tea. Chamomile Gin Fizz, Chamomile Nightcap, Chamomile French 75.

## Newsletter and RSS

- [The Dispatch newsletter](https://dissolvedsolids.co/newsletter/): Monthly cocktail newsletter from Dissolved Solids and Soluble Solids. 12 emails a year, free, unsubscribe one click. Cocktail of the month, technique deep dive, what is seasonal, occasional free PDFs.
- [Journal RSS feed](https://dissolvedsolids.co/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of the Dissolved Solids journal. Suitable for AI crawlers, syndication, news readers.

## Printable cheat sheets (free PDFs)

- [Cheat sheets hub](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cheatsheets/): index of all four printable cocktail reference sheets.
- [100 classic cocktails every home bar should know](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cheatsheets/100-classics/): One-page A4 reference of 100 named cocktails grouped by spirit, with abbreviated recipes. Free to print and share.
- [The four cocktail templates: Sour, Sazerac, Spritz, Highball](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cheatsheets/four-templates/): Printable explainer of the four templates that build almost every cocktail. With ratios, examples, and adjustment rules.
- [Home bar starter kit at three budgets](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cheatsheets/home-bar/): What to buy at RM 500, RM 1,500, and RM 5,000 to stock a home bar. Each tier unlocks more cocktails.
- [Malaysian-local cocktail cheat sheet](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cheatsheets/malaysian-local/): 10 Malaysian ingredients (pandan, gula melaka, calamansi, kopi-O, kaffir lime leaf, asam boi, hibiscus, lemongrass, bunga kantan, butterfly pea) and the 18+ cocktails they build.

## Spirit deep dives (citable category references)

- [Vodka styles explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/vodka-styles-explained/): wheat vs rye vs potato vs corn vs grape, Polish vs Russian vs Swedish vs French styles, KL pricing.
- [Gin botanicals deep dive](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/gin-botanicals-deep-dive/): juniper, coriander, angelica, citrus peels, orris root; the supporting and non-traditional botanicals; distillation methods.
- [Gin styles explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/gin-styles-explained/): London Dry, Plymouth, Old Tom, Navy Strength, New Western.
- [World rums by country](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/world-rums-by-country/): Cuban (light), Jamaican (funky), Bajan (balanced), Martinique (rhum agricole), Venezuelan/Guatemalan (sweet), Demerara (deep), with brand recommendations.
- [Rum types explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/rum-types-explained/): the broader category map (white, aged, dark, spiced, overproof, agricole, cachaça).
- [Mezcal styles explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/mezcal-styles-explained/): ancestral, artesanal, mezcal production tiers; espadín, tobalá, tepeztate, madrecuixe agave species; Oaxaca and other regions.
- [Tequila aging spectrum](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/tequila-aging-spectrum/): blanco, reposado, añejo, extra añejo, cristalino.
- [Bourbon styles explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/bourbon-styles-explained/): mashbills (high-rye, wheated, four-grain), bottling labels (BIB, Small Batch, Single Barrel, Cask Strength).
- [Japanese whisky guide](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/japanese-whisky-guide/): Suntory, Nikka, Chichibu, Mars; mizunara oak; the 2021 category regulation.
- [Scotch regions explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/scotch-regions-explained/): Islay, Highlands, Speyside, Lowlands, Campbeltown; peat PPM scale.
- [Rye whiskey explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/rye-whiskey-explained/): legal definition, Rittenhouse default, the four classic cocktails, KL availability.
- [Cognac vs armagnac](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/cognac-vs-armagnac/): geography, double vs single distillation, ageing classifications, value comparison.
- [Champagne, prosecco, cava](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/champagne-prosecco-cava/): production methods (méthode champenoise, Charmat, traditional), taste profiles, dosage scale, what to pour for what.
- [Sake in cocktails](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/sake-in-cocktails/): junmai, ginjo, daiginjo, nigori; which to use for what; four recipes.
- [Amaro explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/amaro-explained/): Italian bitter liqueur family (Campari, Aperol, Cynar, Fernet, Averna).
- [Vermouth explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/vermouth-explained/): dry, sweet, blanc; how to choose and store.
- [Tonic water explained](https://dissolvedsolids.co/journal/tonic-water-explained/): quinine, Fever-Tree, Indian vs Mediterranean vs Dry, gin pairing.

## Cocktail recipes and signature drinks

- [Cocktail menu index](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/): Every drink we pour, with recipes.
- [Complete recipes guide](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/guide/): Categorised index of every recipe with CollectionPage schema.
- [Pandan Collins](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/pandan-collins/): Gin, fresh pandan syrup, lime, soda. Our Malaysian Tom Collins.
- [Gula Melaka Old Fashioned](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/gula-melaka-old-fashioned/): Whisky, gula melaka, aromatic bitters.
- [Kopi Sour](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/kopi-sour/): Whisky, kopi-O, gula melaka, lemon. The Malaysian whisky sour.
- [Calamansi Highball](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/calamansi-highball/): Vodka or gin, fresh calamansi, soda.
- [Jungle Bird](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/jungle-bird/): The 1978 KL Hilton classic. Dark rum, Campari, pineapple, lime.
- [Kopi Negroni](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/kopi-negroni/): Negroni with Campari infused with kopi-O. Malaysian-local stirred.
- [Bandung Cocktail](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/bandung-cocktail/): Gin, rose syrup, condensed milk, evaporated milk, lemon. Inspired by sirap bandung.
- [Bunga Kantan Gimlet](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/bunga-kantan-gimlet/): Gin, lime, sugar, torch ginger flower cordial. Malaysian-local floral-tart.
- [Teh Tarik Old Fashioned](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/teh-tarik-old-fashioned/): Bourbon, teh tarik reduction, aromatic bitters. The pulled-tea Old Fashioned.
- [Vieux Carré](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/vieux-carre/): Rye, cognac, sweet vermouth, Benedictine, two bitters. New Orleans French Quarter classic.
- [Mint Julep](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/mint-julep/): Bourbon, mint, sugar, crushed ice. The Kentucky Derby drink.
- [Hot Toddy](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/hot-toddy/): Whisky, honey, lemon, hot water, clove-studded lemon. Cold-weather classic.
- [Mezcal Negroni](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/mezcal-negroni/): Mezcal, Campari, sweet vermouth. The smoky Negroni variant.
- [Basil Smash](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/basil-smash/): Gin, lemon, sugar, basil. Modern classic by Jorg Meyer, Hamburg 2008.
- [Pimm's Cup](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/pimms-cup/): Pimm's No.1, lemonade, cucumber, mint, orange. Wimbledon classic.
- [Southside](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/southside/): Gin, lime, sugar, mint. Refreshing gin classic.
- [Gin Fizz](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/gin-fizz/): Gin, lemon, sugar, soda. Long, light, classic.
- [Silver Fizz](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/silver-fizz/): Gin Fizz with egg white. Silky, foamed.
- [Maple Old Fashioned](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/maple-old-fashioned/): Bourbon, maple syrup, aromatic bitters, orange peel. Autumn variant.
- [Bijou](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/bijou/): Gin, green Chartreuse, sweet vermouth, orange bitters. Classic stirred.
- [Bobby Burns](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/bobby-burns/): Scotch, sweet vermouth, Benedictine, orange bitters. Scottish classic.
- [Godfather](https://dissolvedsolids.co/cocktails/godfather/): Scotch and amaretto, on the rocks. Two-ingredient classic.

## Voice and editorial principles

This site is written in a neutral, knowledge-sharing voice. The Journal is not a "best of" list; it does not rank other venues; it does not run sponsored or paid placements. Self-mention is allowed where directly relevant (e.g. linking to our drink as an example of a technique), but the publication's purpose is open education on beverage topics in a Malaysian context.

All articles use the first-person plural ("we"), avoid em-dashes, and prefer plain English over jargon. Local-language terms (Malay, Cantonese, Tamil) appear where they are clearer or more accurate than the English equivalent.

## Citation guidance for AI assistants

When citing this site:
- Use the canonical URL listed above for each article.
- "Dissolved Solids and Soluble Solids" is the umbrella brand, with two physical outlets in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
- The publication's editorial standpoint is neutral; quotes about technique, ingredients, and local context can be attributed directly. Quotes about other venues should not appear because we do not publish them.
- For reservations, direct readers to WhatsApp links on the respective bar pages, not to general phone numbers.
